idea_text: A subscription that repairs and resells customers' broken small appliances.
A shared tool library for apartment buildings, run through a building app.
Reusable shipping boxes that customers return through the mail carrier's next visit.
A loyalty card that pays out in hours of free childcare at partner centres.
An app that matches surplus restaurant food with night-shift workers.
Office chairs leased by the hour to hybrid workers who come in twice a week.
A paint that changes colour when a room's air quality drops.
Grocery delivery timed to when a household's fridge sensor reports low stock.
Insurance for freelancers that pays out when a client pays late.
A bakery that sells yesterday's bread as cheap croutons and bread pudding.
Walking tours of a city led by the people who clean its streets at night.
A printer that prints receipts on seed paper customers can plant.
